q1.explanationZh: 第一段最后一句说，这家书店在加拿大。

evidence.quote: You can also visit this bookshop in Canada.

q2.sampleAnswer: There are many cats in the bookshop. Some are playing around. Some are napping among the books. Some may even be reading Dr. Seuss's The Cat in the Hat.
q2.rubricZh: 要点：店里有很多猫（玩耍、打盹、看书等细节可作补充）。
q2.explanationZh: 第二段说有点“不寻常”的事，就是书店里有好多猫，有的玩，有的睡，还有的像在读书。

keyPoints.descZh: 动物救助组织救了这些猫

q3.rubricZh: 要点：an animal rescue group（动物救助组织）。
q3.explanationZh: 第三段说，这些猫来自一个动物救助组织，是他们救了猫。

evidence.quote: These cats are from an animal

q4.sampleAnswer: No, not everyone. Some people come in just to see the cats, while others don't even know there are cats there.

keyPoints.descZh: 回答否定：不是所有人（No）；有些人是专门来看猫，有些人根本不知道有猫

q4.rubricZh: 要点：否定回答 No / not everyone。
q4.explanationZh: Helmke说，有时人们是来看猫的，有时他们都不知道这里有猫，所以不是所有人都为看猫而来。

evidence.quote: Sometimes people come in just to see the cats.

q5.sampleAnswer: Because in this bookshop, cats get adopted and books get sold.

keyPoints.descZh: 猫被领养，书也卖出去了
examples: cats get adopted and books get sold

q5.rubricZh: 要点：cats get adopted；books get sold。
q5.explanationZh: 最后一段说，猫找到了家，书也卖出去了，两边都有好处，就是双赢。
